environment: Select toolchain and allocate an isolated unbooted simulator
prepare: Add UI-only test target without changing production sources
build: Build complete app for Simulator (no Apple account)
signature: Verify actual simulator signature and Keychain identity
boot: Boot the isolated simulator only after compilation
install_launch: Install and launch the complete app in a fresh simulator
fixture: Seed only an invalid public document for the actual picker
ui: Exercise first setup and local navigation in the real app
postcheck: Verify the selected invalid document was not modified
evidence: Record installation and file-provider services on failure
Retain app stdout and crash reports from the actual test result
cleanup: Shut down only the simulator created by this job
